title: Initial configuration is preserved
statement: Let $M$ be a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine and let $N$ be its associated nondeterministic machine, with the same initial state and both choice transitions equal to the transition of $M$. For every input word $x$, the initial configuration of $N$ on $x$ equals the initial configuration of $M$ on $x$.
hypotheses_covered: Its associated nondeterministic machine has the same initial state and both transitions equal to the deterministic transition
replaced:
Let $M$ be a deterministic multi-tape Turing machine with transition function $\delta$,
let $N$ be the nondeterministic machine with the same initial state whose two transition
functions both equal $\delta$, and let $x$ be an input word.  Then the initial configuration
of $N$ on $x$ coincides with the initial configuration of $M$ on $x$.
